name: Thornling
flavor: A shrub with a grudge and very pointy elbows.

name: Bog Hopper
flavor: A toad the size of a footstool. It thinks you are a fly.

name: Moss Wisp
flavor: A glowing puff of moss. Pretty, until it pecks.

name: Barkback Boar
flavor: Its back is half bark, half rock, and all bad mood.

name: Spore Puffer
flavor: A mushroom that sneezes on purpose.

name: Elder Thornling
flavor: Older, bigger, and still holding the same grudge.

name: Bramble Troll
flavor: Guardian of Mossy Hollow. Mostly guards a nap spot.

name: Pincher Crab
flavor: Walks sideways, holds grudges forwards.

name: Gull Bandit
flavor: Has stolen 400 sandwiches and counting.

name: Brine Slime
flavor: Salty in every sense.

name: Kelp Lurker
flavor: Looks like seaweed. Is seaweed. Is angry seaweed.

name: Shell Knight
flavor: A hermit crab in borrowed armor. Very polite. Very stabby.

name: Big Pincher
flavor: The Pincher Crab everyone else is scared of.

name: Crab King
flavor: Ruler of Saltmarsh Shore. The crown is a bottle cap.

name: Ember Imp
flavor: Laughs at its own jokes. They are not good.

name: Ash Lizard
flavor: Basks on lava rocks. Regrets nothing.

name: Cinder Beetle
flavor: A beetle with a coal for a back.

name: Smog Bat
flavor: Coughs constantly. Mostly on you.

name: Lava Toad
flavor: The Bog Hopper's spicy cousin.

name: Imp Chieftain
flavor: Wears a crown made of other imps' hats.

name: Magma Wyrm
flavor: It lives in the volcano. It IS mostly volcano.

name: Spark Sprite
flavor: A tiny ball of static with a big attitude.

name: Thunder Goat
flavor: Climbs cliffs, eats tin cans, fears nothing.

name: Cliff Harpy
flavor: Sings beautifully. Only knows one song. It is a scream.

name: Gale Hawk
flavor: Faster than you. Smugger than you.

name: Granite Ram
flavor: Its horns are literal rocks. It is very proud of them.

name: Thunderhead
flavor: A grumpy cloud that wants your lunch money.

name: Storm Roc
flavor: A bird so big it has its own weather.

name: Frostbite Hare
flavor: Fluffy, fast, and bites ankles on purpose.

name: Ice Wraith
flavor: A cold draft that learned to hold a grudge.

name: Glacier Turtle
flavor: It has been walking to the same rock for nine years.

name: Yeti Cub
flavor: Small, for a yeti. Large, for everything else.

name: Rime Wolf
flavor: Hunts in packs. This one got lost.

name: Rime Alpha
flavor: The one the pack was looking for.

name: Glacier Hydra
flavor: Three heads, three opinions, one very cold breath.

name: Tunnel Mole
flavor: Cannot see you. Can definitely smell you.

name: Crystal Crawler
flavor: A spider made of gemstones. Priceless. Furious.

name: Lantern Gnome
flavor: Mines for gold. Finds you instead. Disappointed.

name: Gemback Lizard
flavor: Its back is worth a fortune. It knows.

name: Rust Sprite
flavor: A spark that lives in old mine carts.

name: Foreman Golem
flavor: Wears a hard hat. Takes safety very seriously.

name: Iron Golem
flavor: Built to guard the deepest mine. Still guarding. Very sturdy.

name: Dawn Sprite
flavor: Wakes up early and wants everyone to know.

name: Dusk Bat
flavor: Only comes out at twilight. Which is always, up here.

name: Sun Knight
flavor: Polishes its armor between every swing.

name: Shade Stalker
flavor: You can only see it out of the corner of your eye.

name: Twilight Moth
flavor: Half dawn, half dusk, all dust.

name: Eclipse Herald
flavor: Announces the Eclipse Dragon. Loudly. Constantly.

name: Eclipse Dragon
flavor: The oldest dragon in the world. Half sun, half moon, and not in the mood.

name: Murk Toad
flavor: Sits in the mud all day. Is, technically, also mud.

name: Will-o'-Whisper
flavor: A floating lantern that whispers your name. Usually wrong.

name: Reed Stalker
flavor: A long-legged bird that pretends to be a reed. Badly.

name: Bogling
flavor: A small mud goblin who thinks it is very scary.

name: Lily Snapper
flavor: A turtle wearing a lily pad. It is very proud of the lily pad.

name: Old Croaker
flavor: The oldest toad in the Fen. Her croak shakes the reeds.

name: Whisperwillow
flavor: An ancient willow whose branches whisper. Mostly complaints.

name: Cog Crawler
flavor: A clockwork beetle. Ticks when it is thinking. Ticks a lot.

name: Brass Sentry
flavor: Still guarding the gate. The gate fell down 300 years ago.

name: Boiler Bot
flavor: A round little boiler on legs. Whistles when angry. Always whistling.

name: Spark Hound
flavor: A clockwork dog with a coal for a heart. Very good boy. Very hot boy.

name: Gargoyle Pup
flavor: A stone gargoyle that only just woke up. It is grumpy about it.

name: Captain Clank
flavor: The fortress captain, a dented automaton who still salutes everyone.

name: Cinderforge Colossus
flavor: The ruins' last guardian, a stone giant with a furnace for a heart.

name: Hoot Shade
flavor: An owl made of night. Asks "who?" and never likes the answer.

name: Frostcap Shroom
flavor: A glowing ice mushroom. Bonks things. Mostly shins.

name: Snickerbark
flavor: A walking stump that giggles at its own spooky stories.

name: Shadow Fox
flavor: A fox of shadow with a moon-silver tail. Steals socks. Nobody knows why.

name: Rimeback Badger
flavor: A badger with frosty fur and a permanently bad mood.

name: Duskhorn
flavor: The great stag of the night woods. Its antlers hold the stars.

name: Moonwell Wyrm
flavor: A serpent made of night sky that lives in the moonwell and steals dreams.

name: Sand Scarab
flavor: A beetle with a golden shell. Rolls things. Mostly you.

name: Mirage Jackal
flavor: Is it there? Is it not? It is there, and it is biting.

name: Glimmer Lizard
flavor: A lizard that sunbathes so hard it started to glow.

name: Dune Sentinel
flavor: A sandstone statue that guards a door. The door is long gone.

name: Treasure Mimic
flavor: Looks like treasure. Has teeth. Was not treasure.

name: Riddle Sphinx
flavor: Asks a riddle. Never waits for the answer. Pounces.

name: Aurum Basilisk
flavor: A golden basilisk. Its gaze turns things to gold, including, it hopes, you.

name: Shardling
flavor: A hedgehog whose quills fell from the sky. It is very proud of them.

name: Frostwing Moth
flavor: Drawn to light. Unfortunately for you, your dragon glows.

name: Comet Pup
flavor: Fell out of a comet and kept running. Has not stopped since.

name: Glass Golem
flavor: Made of ice so clear you can see its tiny frozen heart. It would rather you did not.

name: Astral Owlet
flavor: Too young to fly, old enough to judge you.

name: Prism Stag
flavor: Its antlers split starlight into every color. It never stops posing.

name: Starwarden
flavor: The owl-griffin who keeps the fallen stars. Counts them every night and is never pleased.

name: Rift Mite
flavor: A tiny bug with a hole in its back. Things fall in. Nobody knows where they go.

name: Shardhorn Goat
flavor: Rock shards orbit its horns. It headbutts with all of them at once.

name: Gloom Gulper
flavor: A floating blob that is mostly mouth. The rest of it is also mouth.

name: Rubble Crab
flavor: Wears a floating boulder as a shell. Very proud of it. Will not stop talking about it.

name: Echo Bat
flavor: Its ears are bigger than the rest of it. It hears your thoughts, and finds them boring.

name: Voidstrider
flavor: A tall stone heron with a window of nothing where its heart should be. It walks very slowly, on purpose.

name: Nullmaw
flavor: A huge stone toad whose belly is a hole in the world. It is always hungry, and it is never full.

name: Reef Stalker
flavor: An eel with a lantern on its head. The light is friendly. The eel is not.

name: Storm Gull
flavor: Steals fish, chips and lightning. Mostly fish.

name: Barnacle Brute
flavor: More barnacle than brute these days. Still very much a brute.

name: Squall Sprite
flavor: A grumpy little cloud. Rains on everyone, itself included.

name: Drowned Sentry
flavor: Still guarding a gate that sank a hundred years ago. Nobody told it.

name: Thunder Ray
flavor: A manta ray that swims through the sky when it storms. It storms a lot here.

name: Tidelord
flavor: King of the drowned city. Wears a coral crown and demands to be bowed to. Underwater.

name: Rot Grub
flavor: A fat little grub that eats rotten things. It thinks you look a bit rotten.

name: Thornvine Creeper
flavor: A walking tangle of thorny vine. It has no face, which is somehow worse.

name: Spore Toad
flavor: Puffs out its cheeks and a cloud of spores comes out the back. Every time.

name: Mire Lurker
flavor: A mossy crocodile that has been lying in the same puddle for nine years. Patient.

name: Gloomcap Walker
flavor: A mushroom that got tired of sitting still. Now it walks, grumpily.

name: Rotwood Ent
flavor: An old tree that caught the rot and got very cross about it.

name: Rotroot Queen
flavor: The oldest tree in the thicket, hollow and sick and very, very grumpy about both.

name: Cinder Monkey
flavor: Steals your lunch and sets it on fire. Then eats it anyway.

name: Flame Lily
flavor: Beautiful, fragrant, and very hungry.

name: Magma Tortoise
flavor: Takes a hundred years to cross the jungle. Not in a hurry.

name: Jungle Raptor
flavor: Fast, clever, and definitely smiling at you.

name: Ember Parrot
flavor: Learned three words. All of them rude.

name: Vine Tyrant
flavor: King of the jungle canopy, by his own announcement.

name: Volcanadon
flavor: A dinosaur with a volcano on its back. It has never once been in a good mood.

name: Rivet Beetle
flavor: Its shell is held together with rivets. Nobody knows who put them there.

name: Thunder Hound
flavor: Howls when lightning strikes. Lightning strikes a lot.

name: Iron Hawk
flavor: Feathers like knives. Very proud of them. Polishes them daily.

name: Static Ferret
flavor: Rubbed itself on a carpet once and never recovered.

name: Scrap Wolf
flavor: Wears armor it found lying around. Some of it is a bucket.

name: Lightning Lynx
flavor: The fastest thing in the mountains. Including the lightning.

name: Ferrovane
flavor: The oldest dragon in the mountains, scaled in steel. She remembers when the mountains were young.

name: Gust Sprite
flavor: A little whirl of wind with eyes. It steals hats, and it has a lot of hats.

name: Sunwing Moth
flavor: A moth the size of a sail. It has finally found the brightest lamp of all: the sun.

name: Cloud Ram
flavor: A fluffy ram made of thundercloud. Its headbutts come with a free haircut.

name: Prism Hawk
flavor: Its feathers bend the light, so there always seem to be three of it.

name: Sky Eel
flavor: Swims through the clouds as if they were water. It is very confused by actual water.

name: Sunscale Griffin
flavor: Half eagle, half lion, all show-off. It polishes its own feathers between fights.

name: Aurelith
flavor: A whale as big as an island that swims through the sky. It carries three islands on its back and is tired of all of them.

name: Star Mote
flavor: A tiny fallen star that wants to go home. It is very cross about the whole thing.

name: Null Hound
flavor: A dog-shaped hole in the world. It still wags. Nobody knows what with.

name: Comet Lizard
flavor: Runs so fast it leaves a trail of sparkles. It has never once stopped to see them.

name: Empty Coat
flavor: A long coat with nobody inside. It would very much like yours.

name: Orbit Jelly
flavor: A jellyfish floating in starlight, with three tiny moons circling it like pets.

name: Gloam Stalker
flavor: A great cat made of the dark between stars. You only see it when it blinks.

name: Nyxaris
flavor: A dragon whose wings are half a night sky and half nothing at all. She has been guarding the rift since before there were stars to count.

name: Crown Mole
flavor: A mole wearing a bottle cap for a crown. It believes it is the rightful king. Nobody has argued.

name: Lantern Wraith
flavor: A little ghost carrying a lantern full of darkness. It lights the way to nowhere.

name: Gemback Armadillo
flavor: Its shell is studded with gems. It rolls up into a ball whenever anyone looks at it greedily.

name: Shadow Jester
flavor: The shadow of the old court jester. The jester left a thousand years ago. The shadow stayed for the jokes.

name: Pillar Knight
flavor: A suit of stone armor still guarding a door that fell down centuries ago.

name: Shadow Chancellor
flavor: The king's old advisor, now mostly cloak and whispers. Still taking notes on everyone.

name: Hollow King
flavor: A giant king of stone on a throne of stone, with a crown and nothing underneath it. He has waited a thousand years for someone to bow.

name: Scald Puff
flavor: A little cloud of steam with a kettle's temper. It whistles when it's angry, which is always.

name: Magma Crab
flavor: A crab with a shell of cooling lava. Its pinches are hot. Its hugs are worse.

name: Glacier Seal
flavor: A round seal with a little iceberg on its back. Sleepy until it is not.

name: Monsoon Heron
flavor: Brings the rain wherever it goes. It has never once been dry and is quite smug about it.

name: Brimstone Newt
flavor: Smells of rotten eggs and burnt toast. Very proud of both.

name: Coral Colossus
flavor: A giant made of living reef. Small fish live in its armpits and pay no rent.

name: Seethe
flavor: A great serpent with two heads, one of lava and one of sea water. They have been arguing for three hundred years, and the steam has never stopped.

name: Star Sprite
flavor: A star that fell, bounced, and decided it liked it down here. It is very bright and very rude about it.

name: Dusk Moth
flavor: A fat moth that only comes out at dusk. It eats moonlight and leaves crumbs.

name: Meteor Tortoise
flavor: Its shell is a meteorite that landed on it a thousand years ago. It has been carrying it ever since, out of pride.

name: Nightcap Owl
flavor: Stays up all night counting stars. Gets very cross if you make it lose count.

name: Comet Ferret
flavor: Fast as a comet and twice as nosy. It has stolen something from everyone on the mountain.

name: Eclipse Sentinel
flavor: A stone guardian with a face of sun and shadow. It has guarded the summit since before the mountain was finished.

name: Vesperax
flavor: The star that fell. It landed on the summit an age ago, grew a body out of the night sky, and has been catching every falling star since so nobody else can wish on them.

name: Wisp Drake
flavor: The ghost of a baby dragon from long ago, still playing in the valley. It does not know it is a ghost and nobody has told it.

name: Rustback Beetle
flavor: Its shell is iron, and the iron is rusty, and the beetle is very sensitive about it.

name: Moldwing Bat
flavor: A bat with mushrooms growing on its head. It thinks they make it look distinguished.

name: Hush Fox
flavor: A fox that shushes everything. Its tail ends in a little hole in the world, and things that fall in are never heard from again.

name: Relic Golem
flavor: A little golem the first keepers built to sweep the nests. It has kept sweeping for a thousand years. The nests are very clean.

name: Mossback Keeper
flavor: An ancient tortoise who kept the nests before the keepers came. Moss on its shell, a lantern on a stick, and no patience for visitors.

name: Ossarion
flavor: The Old Guardian of Dragonsrest, the last of the first dragons. He has guarded the empty nests for a thousand years, and his beard has grown very long.
